ref: ADR-0003: a pattern that does not translate to an XPath picture is a design-time error; ADR-0026 pattern params (#74 amendment): invalid-parameter-value at the box, naming the element (the integer digits ,##0)
note: The pattern ,##0. A grouping separator before the first digit: DecimalFormat takes it as grouping by three, and the translation takes only #s, then 0s, with single separators between digits. Compiling refuses it at N1.
